deploy.startCommand: mkdir -p .streamlit && printf 'SUPABASE_URL = "%s"\nSUPABASE_KEY = "%s"\n' "$SUPABASE_URL" "$SUPABASE_KEY" > .streamlit/secrets.toml && streamlit run main.py --server.address 0.0.0.0 --server.port $PORT --server.fileWatcherType none --browser.gatherUsageStats false --client.showErrorDetails false --client.toolbarMode minimal
